summary: Estonia's NDC embeds EU-level ecosystem targets. In conservation, it reports a national LULUCF net removals target of -434 Kt CO2eq for 2030, contributing to the EU collective target of -310 Mt CO2-eq by 2030. For restoration, it references the EU target to place restoration measures on at least 20% of EU land and sea areas by 2030, and highlights rewetting/restoring peatlands and wetlands (51–54 Mt CO2-eq/yr EU potential) and reforestation with sustainable forest management (8–235 Mt CO2-eq/yr) as key measures. In agriculture, it includes improving fertiliser use efficiency to cut nitrous oxide emissions (19 Mt CO2-eq/yr). These pledges are set against Estonia's landscape, which is 59.1% forest, 25.2% agriculture, and 4.6% wetland.

targets.metric: Restoration measures in EU land and sea areas
Fertiliser use efficiency to cut nitrous oxide emissions
